title: Oxygenation in Vascular Lesions of the Colon
official: Oxygenation in Vascular Lesions of the Colon
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate oxygenation in the colon in people with acquired vascular abnormalities in the proximal colon.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Undergo standard of care colonoscopy
* People with a history of vascular lesions of the colon
* People with healthy colon
* 18 - 89 years of age

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 years
* Age \> 90 years
* People with ulcerations in at ascending colon opposite the ileocecal valve
* Previous colon surgery
